title: State types for each phase
statement: For state types $S_P$ and $S_Q$, assign to the six phases of a guessing-and-running computation the following state types: $S_P$ in the setup phase, the two-state nondeterministic writer type in the guessing phase, the four-state seek type in each of the skipping and rewind phases, $S_Q$ in the deterministic run phase, and the Boolean verdict type in the output phase.
